title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, section map and answer technique (all sections)
Know the exam format and the six sections with their weights; know what is new in the exam guide launched in August 2026; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide and certification page

toc.title: What is new in the current exam guide

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Exam Google Cloud Digital Leader (a foundational, business-level exam)
Time 90 minutes
Questions 50 to 60 multiple-choice questions
Languages English, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French
Delivery Online-proctored or onsite-proctored
Validity Three years
Prerequisites None; experience collaborating with technical professionals is recommended
Renewal A shorter renewal exam (45 minutes, 20 questions) is available from 180 days before expiry

The passing score is not published, so this course does not quote one. Prices change, so check the official page before you book.

Exam tip

. This exam is about business value, not commands. Questions describe a company with a goal and ask for the Google Cloud idea or product that fits. You never type code.

2The six sections

Section Weight Topics
1. Digital transformation with Google Cloud ~18% Why the cloud, cloud concepts, service models, shared responsibility
2. Exploring data transformation ~18% Value of data, data products, analytics and streaming
3. Innovating with Google Cloud AI ~18% AI, ML, generative AI and agentic AI, Google Cloud AI solutions
4. Modernize infrastructure and applications ~18% Migration, compute, containers, serverless, APIs, hybrid
5. Trust and security with Google Cloud ~18% Security concepts, Google's security products, trust and compliance
6. Scaling with Google Cloud operations ~10% Costs, observability, reliability, SRE
Exam tip

. Five sections carry about 18% each; operations carries 10%. Do not skip a section: no section is small.

3What is new in the current exam guide

The exam guide launched on August 12, 2026 replaced the older guide. The older web page for the guide still shows the older weights; follow the PDF guide.

Area New or changed emphasis
AI Generative AI and agentic AI; Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AI Hypercomputer, pre-built AI agents
Data AlloyDB, Autoclass for Cloud Storage, Managed Service for Apache Spark, data supply chain, openness and interoperability
Modernization Spot VMs, Cloud Run functions, GKE Enterprise, AlloyDB Omni and BigQuery Omni for multicloud
Security Google Threat Intelligence, Security Command Center, Google Security Operations, AI Protection, Model Armor, security of every layer of the AI stack
Operations Observability suite, SLIs and SLOs, Dynamic Workload Scheduler and spot VMs for cost control

4How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line to see what is asked: a benefit, a product, a model or a best practice.
  2. Find the business goal in the scenario (cut cost, move fast, analyze data, protect data, scale).
  3. Eliminate answers that are too technical or that do not fit the goal.
  4. Prefer managed and serverless products over do it yourself, unless the scenario needs control.
  5. Answer every question; there is no penalty stated for a wrong answer.
Exam tip

. When two answers fit, choose the one that is more managed, more scalable and needs the least effort to run.

5A study plan

Phase Modules Goal
1 1 to 2 Cloud concepts and Google Cloud basics
2 3 to 5 Data and analytics
3 6 to 7 AI, generative AI and agents
4 8 to 9 Migration, compute, containers, serverless, APIs
5 10 to 11 Security and trust
6 12 to 13 Costs, operations and reliability
7 14 Exam technique and final review

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate asks how many questions the Cloud Digital Leader exam has. Which statement is correct?

  • A100 to 125 adaptive questions in two hours
  • B30 case-study questions in 60 minutes
  • C50 to 60 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes
  • D20 simulation tasks in three hours of lab testing
Show the answer

Answer: C. The exam has 50 to 60 multiple-choice questions and lasts 90 minutes.

S2A candidate finds an exam guide web page with different section weights than the PDF guide. Which should the candidate follow?

  • AThe web page, because it is easier to read
  • BThe older guide, because it has more detail
  • CThe PDF guide launched in August 2026
  • DWhichever guide has the higher percentages
Show the answer

Answer: C. The PDF guide launched on August 12, 2026 is the current one; the older page shows earlier weights.

S3Which section of the exam has the smallest weight?

  • ATrust and security with Google Cloud, about 18 percent
  • BInnovating with Google Cloud AI, about 18 percent
  • CScaling with Google Cloud operations, about 10 percent
  • DExploring data transformation, about 18 percent
Show the answer

Answer: C. Scaling with Google Cloud operations is about 10 percent; the other five are about 18 percent each.

S4A question describes a retailer that wants to analyze sales data without managing servers. What is the best approach to the question?

  • ALook for the answer with the most technical commands
  • BPick the answer that is managed and serverless for analytics
  • CChoose the answer with the longest list of products
  • DSkip the question because it has no code
Show the answer

Answer: B. Business-level questions favor managed, serverless products that meet the stated goal with the least effort.

S5After three years a credential holder wants to renew with a shorter exam. When can the renewal exam be taken?

  • AStarting 180 days before the expiration date
  • BAt any time during the three years
  • COnly after the credential has expired
  • DOnly with a signed letter from an employer manager
Show the answer

Answer: A. The renewal exam is available starting 180 days before the credential expires.

S6Which topic is a new emphasis of the August 2026 exam guide?

  • AMainframe printing services at scale
  • BPhysical data center design
  • CAgentic AI and generative AI
  • DManual database patching
Show the answer

Answer: C. The 2026 guide adds generative AI and agentic AI to the AI section.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam?

Show the answer

90 minutes.

R2How many sections does the guide have?

Show the answer

Six.

R3Which section has about 10 percent?

Show the answer

Scaling with Google Cloud operations.

R4How long is the credential valid?

Show the answer

Three years.

R5How long is the renewal exam?

Show the answer

45 minutes with 20 questions.

R6Is the passing score published?

Show the answer

No.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 90 minutes, 50 to 60 multiple choice, valid three years
Weights five sections about 18 percent, operations about 10 percent
Guide the PDF launched in August 2026; the older web page is out of date
New generative and agentic AI, Agent Platform, AI Hypercomputer, security for the AI stack
Method business goal first, eliminate, choose the managed and scalable answer
